notes.title: Hotfix version 1.2.2
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the game would hang when starting as Mortar.

notes.title: Plunge v1.2.1 Major Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello! [/b][/h1]

This feature has been long overdue, but we're happy to announce Auto Save is here! You can now resume your in progress run in the event of an application crash, critical bug (still please tell us about those), or if you just want to take a break and quit for a bit. 

We appreciate the feedback so please let us know how this new feature works out for you. 

- Spooky Buns Team

notes.title: Plunge v1.1.4 Hotfix Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello! [/b][/h1]

Thank you for taking the time to play Plunge and leave feedback. The following hotfixes will be going live shortly.

- Darkened floors and camera issues no more! The bug where floors will appear to be "unlit" or split is now fixed.

[strike]-Added localization support for Russian languages. наслаждаться![/strike] (sorry this will be in super soon I promise xD)

If you find yourself stuck while playing any portion of the game, please continue to leave feedback in the Community Discussions threads. We are actively working on continuing fixes for Plunge, so stay posted for more!

- Spooky Buns Team

notes.title: Patch v1.0.19 - Remapping Controls
notes.notes:
Hello!

Upon hearing feedback from the community, we have added functionality to remap keyboard controls for Plunge.

Upon entering the menu, a new "Rebind Movement" Option will be available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536823/ebabe634818e880579ecce9d5ca3bac333e9fbe0.png[/img]

You may then set the movement keys to any keys in any configuration desired. No more turning your keyboard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35536823/532509e1783b4f4d12e6482a6e69a00fb80c432d.png[/img]

Additionally, we have continued to fix problematic floors, hopefully removing all unreachable tiles from the game. If you encounter any unreachable tiles in v.1.0.19, please continue to let us know using the Community Discussion board.

Thank you for your patience as we continue to work on the quality of Plunge!

- Spooky Buns Team

notes.title: Hotfix v.1.0.16 - Even More Fixes!
notes.notes:
Here's the patch notes for the most recent update:

-Fixed Steam achievement "Connoisseur" so it can be properly attained when drinking all potions.
-Fixed issue where Arithmaphobia potion was not functioning properly with Boss health bars.
-Fixed issue where Arithmaphobia potion was not properly negated with then Iron Tum charge.
-Fixed several floors with unreachable tiles.

Please let us know if any additional bugs pop up and we'll do our best to squash them with haste!

-Spooky Buns Team

notes.title: Plunge Hotfix v1.0.15
notes.notes:
Fixes:
-Fixed several floors that contained unreachable tiles.
-Fixed issue where some potions were not properly triggering on hit effects (Ghost and Shimmer).
-Fixed issue where sometimes player statuses would not start or end properly.
-Fixed issue where player health bar UI reports the wrong health value.
-Fixed typos in 'Heavy Metal' and 'Adaptive' Charge descriptions.

Thank you for your patience in these fixes. Please let us know if any additional bugs are found in our community hub discussions!

-Spooky Buns Team
